name: prompt-deck
description: Saves prompts you send again and again and puts them as buttons above the prompt in the desktop app: one click sends. Send by name with /p <name>, manage with /deck. With sidekick also the Later button.

laterButton.title: Later button
laterButton.description: Desktop, above the prompt, while Claude works: the Later button. Needs sidekick with Queue on. Also /deck buttons later on|off.

promptButtons.title: Prompt buttons
promptButtons.description: Desktop, above the prompt: up to 4 buttons of saved prompts. Off hides all, each prompt keeps its own setting. Also /deck buttons prompts on|off.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /deck language.
